title: Studio end-matter integration
why: Implement the owner-approved blog side of LifeOS Article Studio Phase 10: closing sections belong in MDX where they render, preserving existing article output and validating citation targets. The main Studio roadmap remains in LifeOS; this bounded blog record tracks its repository-specific implementation evidence.
done_when: Five original articles migrate without changing prose or rendered content; compiler rejects malformed end matter/citations; authoring template/docs and local build/link/draft/demo checks pass; implementation evidence recorded.

phases.title: MDX closing sections
phases.useful_alone: Articles are authored in display order with compiler-validated references and unchanged rendering.
phases.done_when: Migration, parser validation, documentation and output comparison pass.

items.text: Complete the end-matter compiler/layout integration, migrate all five original demo articles, and document the new format without changing site layout or publication eligibility.

evidence.value: Completed five original MDX migrations with unchanged prose/metadata values. Compared all five rendered article pages with /tmp/blog-base/dist: byte-identical HTML after normalizing the generated CSS filename only. Parser validates structural errors, duplicate ids/attributes, unsafe links and missing citations. npm run build, check:build (including parser checks) and check:demos pass; 48 pages built. Physical browser/theme acceptance is not inferred.

Updated authoring guide, architecture, README and article template. Recovered Claude partial code from active JSONL and finished its parser/schema/layout/route migration. Main product integration is tracked by LifeOS r-261029-01 Phase 10. Implementation commit evidence follows after commit.
